validation_loop_workflow.overview: Iterative validation mode that performs multiple review passes on recently implemented changes, fixing issues found in each pass until the implementation is verified as correct and complete.

step.details: - Identify what was just implemented or changed - Understand the original user requirements - Locate the affected files and components

pass.name: correctness
pass.title: Correctness & Functionality Check

checks.check: Changes match the original requirements exactly
Logic is correct with no off-by-one errors, wrong conditions, or missing cases
No regressions introduced to existing functionality
Error handling is present and correct
Run available tests or linting to catch issues programmatically

pass.action_on_issues: Fix all issues found before proceeding to pass 2. Document what was found and fixed.

pass.name: quality
pass.title: Quality & Completeness Check

checks.check: Code style is consistent with the rest of the codebase
No leftover TODO comments, debug logging, or placeholder code
Documentation is updated if needed (comments, README, docstrings)
No unused imports, variables, or dead code introduced
Naming is clear and follows project conventions
No hardcoded values that should be configurable
Integration with existing code is clean (no awkward workarounds)

pass.action_on_issues: Fix all issues found. If fixes in pass 2 introduced new concerns, perform an additional mini-pass to verify those fixes.

pass.name: optional_deep_check
pass.condition: if issues were found in passes 1-2
pass.title: Regression Verification

checks.check: Fixes from previous passes did not introduce new issues
Run tests again if any code was modified
Final confirmation that requirements are fully met

summary_format.section: Issues found in Pass 1 (and fixes applied)
Issues found in Pass 2 (and fixes applied)
Final status: PASS or additional actions needed

criteria.criterion: All validation passes complete with no remaining issues
Changes verified to match original requirements
